notes.title: Full version has been released today!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Piko Pikoers!

We would like to thank you for your patience. The developer and we have overcome the pandemic, and after two years of development, we are glad to announce that we have released the FULL VERSION of Piko Piko today!

The developer has made many adjustments to improve the overall quality, and here are some adjustments that we would like to share with you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35101177/b10fec626bffc3e6fa7cfb5aad891a4949dee8f4.gif

Patch Notes
[olist]
 Added new animation for Nyan
 Added 4 new mana-costing power-ups for Nyan
 Adjusted the Dash control and can now be activated by pressing forward twice
 Added 6 new achievements
 Adjusted how players can access the Ice area in the 2nd parts
 Added new bomb item
 Added different types of life/mana upgrades in multiple areas
 Added stores in multiple locations
 Adjusted the beginning part of the game, so it is now easier to access the tower
 Adjusted mini car gameplay for nyan
 Fixed soft-lock issues in certain areas
 Other minor fixes
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35101177/65b150362070154a16a01b1cce3e8c0ed83e1004.gif

We have also revised the price along with the official release.
The price is a little higher than before, but we hope you will continue to support us and share the info about this game with your friends.

Last but not least... have you noticed something NEW in the following GIFs?
Piko will be back soon, maybe sooner than you expected! Let's look forward to it together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35101177/d887a59fa4683e27ca4b0a366786b6475872b992.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35101177/c61d3f990e14385b7c806797fc1a100fd32375fa.gif

If you want to know more about what's coming next, please follow the developer on Twitter!
https://twitter.com/marquetgames

notes.title: Piko Patch Notes
notes.content:
Piko Piko is celebrating Halloween in style with all-new pumpkin enemies scattered throughout the game -- a permanent edition to the game's bestiary, delivered just in time for the season!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35101177/2a522c15c275efb002d7a5eb2c79303792833c36.jpg

Additionally, we have a few fixes and tweaks for y'all, too:


Badge display moved to above the minimap.

Music added to the tower area after beating the boss

Boss in Tower - Boss in Tower remains after defeated. Nyan will attack the defeated boss graphic.
This has been fixed for all bosses.

Underwater Area - There is no way to destroy the spiked mines with attacks. Only touching them & taking damage destroys them.
Regular attacks can now destroy mines.

Underground Area - TV enemies have too much HP, causing player to get hit. Not fair to player.
Their HP has been lowered.

Snow Area - Ice Cave, Angel Statue at the bottom of the cave does not save the game. It only heals HP?
Angel Statue now saves in this location.

Drill is still way too powerful. Deals the most damage to bosses. No need to stun the bosses at all; just keep using the drill to win.
Drill has been severely nerfed.


*Note: A new glitch has been introduced with this build, which sees some graphical distortion on certain enemy sprites throughout the game. This does not affect gameplay, but it has been noted and logged, and will be addressed in the next build.

We hope you have a very nice time with Piko Piko this Halloween season and beyond, and we promise, things are shaping up for this game! Slowly but surely, it's all coming together.

Thanks for your patience, support, and feedback as we continue to make this game better and better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35101177/837abc51e4056dc3039c85855641f8218d6b28d3.gif

Fixed random Fire stage teleport glitch
Finished ice area
Added the final areas
Fixed some text errors
Fixed bug on the city special boss
Physics have been/are being redone
New damage system is being implemented

*There are still other issues in the game currently, but please do rest assured that we are doing our best to get things cleaned up as fast as we can! The "EXIT TO MENU" in-game pause menu option still does not work, and the SFX/music volume is still unbalanced, but we definitely haven't forgotten about these issues! Sorry for any continued inconvenience, however. This is still a work in progress, so please bear with us just a bit longer!

******

To all our Piko Piko fans,

This is an incremental update in terms of bug-fixes, but a huge one in terms of added content, since it now opens the entire game to testers -- you should now be able to complete it, from beginning to end! And there's a LOT to see and do.

The focus this period has been on getting it done, however, so there may be some leftover bugs from last time, as well as newly introduced ones, that could cause you some problems here and there. Such things come with the territory, however, and I think you'll agree that it'll all be worth it in the end once this game is finished and ready for its big debut!

Thanks for sticking with us throughout this process, and please be sure to watch this space for future updates as well. Take care, stay safe, and I look forward to reading your impressions in the community!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Piko Patch Notes - Version 0.18 - March 5th
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35101177/b10fec626bffc3e6fa7cfb5aad891a4949dee8f4.gif
Patch Notes
Fixed instance where Nyan says "JUMP!" twice in a row.
Added new SFX for when Piko takes her hammer from her house.
Fixed Teacher-Sensei's dialog bubble from being cut off the screen.
Fixed Nyan's helmet light so that it properly shines in Elizabeths face during post fight dialog scene.
Fixed light source around Piko's body.
Fixed the crash / softlock that would happen if you died on the boss in the tutorial.
Fixed the issue when the player would get stuck by entering Hideki's boss room a second time.
Fixed being unable to navigate the option screen with a controller. (Button functionality still being adjusted as functionality still not consolidated for all screens.
Fixed PRESS START on the pre-game settings menu.
Fixed the softlock that would occur if player continuously pressed attack during the Nyan / Piko reunited event underground.
Fixed the malfunctioning Nyan robot event will cause the game to soft-lock if the player ignores the robot and walks off the map.
Fixed issue where If Piko dies in the lava right after she defeated Yutaka, the game will take her back to the save point.
Fixed issue where pots could only be broken by the drill attack. Pots will now break from normal and drill attacks. Plus have a small chance to drop money also.
Added a new simple Tutorial to the game. (Before Piko wakes up in her house)
Fire Area has been redesigned to make it easier to navigate.
Added proper functionality to Bicycle NPC event so player can unlock the correct achievement.
Added pick up items to certain areas of the map. For example "Speed Up" which permanently increases Piko's movement speed. (A lot of this is still being adjusted and subject to change)
Removed the Uppercut attack functionality from default use.
Removed the jumping charge drill attack functionality from default use. 
Various of other smaller minor bug fixes. (We have managed to close out around 50 issues with our tracking database!)
*There are still other issues in the game currently but please do rest assured that we are doing our best to get things cleaned up as fast as we can! Currently the "EXIT TO MENU" in game pause menu option does not work also. As functionality had to be changed last minuted from the PAX build, that also included full save data wiping for demo play purposes.

Also one large issue that we are looking into with this current build is that the SFX / Music volume levels are really low even when adjusting the slider on the pre-launch options menu. But we will be sure to have that fixed for the next build as soon as possible and do apologize about the trouble in advance.

******

To all our Piko Piko fans,

First off we would like to give our most sincere apologies for the long delays with the latest update. As you can see by the version number we have jumped a few versions due to some major issues with previous builds that took some time to fix.

One of the largest issues too that should be working correctly is the inability to progress out from the underground town due to the Neko event not triggering correctly. There were various problems with how the event flags were not working correctly to trigger the event where you bring back ingredients to Neko, which then triggers the event that allows the player to leave the underground. Although currently in this build, shortly after the game will end with a thank you for playing the early access build screen. The proper events after this are still being adjusted so that people will be able to proceed correctly to the new zones for the next build.

As you can see there have been various other fixes made, though we are still trying to continue to find and resolve issues where Piko can become stuck in the terrain.

We had received a lot of positive / constructive feedback from users during our time at PAX East and we thank those who came to visit us!

As always we give our must humble thanks for all of your patience and support!

For those who want to report bugs or leave feedback please use the links below!

Feedback

notes.title: Alpha Branch instruction access for Piko Piko Early Access
notes.content:
Instructions on how to access the "Alpha branch for the latest version of Piko Piko"

Early Access users can access the branch by following the steps below. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35101177/7dde3795b0f894fe8331cf7596064af3a543a63a.png

In your Steam game Library, right click on Piko Piko and select "Properties" in the drop down menu.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35101177/fba0500c79ad758676cf4c937fe34b25a2120461.png

On the Piko Piko - Properties window select the "BETAS" tab.
Enter the beta access code "pikopikopiko" then press the "CHECK CODE" button.

Hello fellow Piko Pikoers!

Thank you for your patience during the pause between updates! Marquet has been working hard on adjusting the game to allow for proper text implementation with the title for all of the languages, which will be a huge help for development.

The explanation would be quite long, but the short of it is the new resolution changes has allowed for the use of standard text font. Therefore cutting down the need with implementation and adjusting of localized text. This also includes English.

When starting up the game the current initial settings screen cannot be navigated with a controller at the moment so please use the keyboard to make adjustments to the settings and starting the game.

With the new changes and new issues that will appear, we have decided to make Version 0.07 on a Alpha branch of the game. So users can also go back to playing with the previous version as we work on adjustments to the newer build.

Early Access users can access the branch by following the steps below. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35101177/7dde3795b0f894fe8331cf7596064af3a543a63a.png

Enter the beta access code "pikopikopiko" then press the "CHECK CODE" button.
"Access code correct, private beta 'pikoalphatest' is now available" will display under the beta access code section.

Close the window.
Back in your library Piko Piko should display as "Piko Piko [pikoalphatest]"
To switch back to the previous version, just open the beta drop down menu again and select the Opt out of all Beta options


As always we would like to thank everyone for their support and patience during early access and hope you will continue to enjoy the game!

Here is the new Nyan Drill toss who want to see it in action. Its pretty OP currently if you can hit a boss multiple times with it in a row so its very much so still a work in progress! :)

notes.title: Piko Piko is Now Available on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
Piko Piko fans, 

We thank you for your patience and understanding with the initial delay and are proud to announce that Piko Piko is now available for purchase on Steam Early Access!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079200/Piko_Piko/

Below is the same information as the Early Access description text. Posting it here also for ease of reading.

Why Early Access?
“Our goal is to help create a more well rounded and polished end product with the help from user feedback. At the same time we hope to create a community of passionate users who enjoy taking part of the feedback and development process with a title! With the main groundwork of the title having been completed, we thought this would be the perfect opportunity to incorporate the community with the development of the game. By listening to the feedback and ideas from the vast amount of players from various cultural backgrounds here on Steam, we hope to work together to create a well rounded product fans from all over the world can enjoy!”

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
“The game is planned to be in Early Access for 4 months at the absolute latest. Depending on the speed of development and polishing of the product based off of user feedback we are aiming towards a release at the end of October or November 2019.”

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
“The following list below are the features and additions that we will be working towards and adjusting based on player feedback during the development process!


New game modes, Boss Rush
New Playable character with new lore
+ 1-2 hours of gameplay
Upgrades and powers
A lot of new enemies
8 New Bosses
New features based on community feedback
New Quests
Full Controller Support
Achievements
Trading Cards
Cloud Save functionality planned
Localization into other languages - Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean, French, Spanish. Not all of these may make it into the game at launch.”


What is the current state of the Early Access version?
“Currently the game is in about a 70% complete state with area assets having been created and connected, gives the player a very good idea of how the general gameplay mechanics are. More complex work such as event triggers, NPC dialog adjustment and formatting and control functionality are being worked on. There are still sections of the game where the player might become stuck due to issues with map connectivity / being still currently worked on. And the final favorite of developers and players all over the world this early access version will contain bugs. So please bear with us as we work towards hammering out all of these issues during the Early Access period!


8 Bosses, Being 3 hidden
Base part of the game and story content (+- 2-3 hours gameplay)
6 Game Areas (13 planned for the Full Release)
2 Item Upgrades


As a heads up to our Early Access users, while controller functionality is supported we still are in the phase of doing proper adjustments so we can have it marked correctly as "Full Controller Support". Be sure to have your controller plugged in and turned on before starting the game.

Achievements and Trading Cards will be added to the game during the development process and we will be sure to inform everyone once they are properly implemented and active.”

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
“The price will increase after Early Access ends.

We plan on doing an official announcement at least 1 month in advance to notify people that Early Access will be ending and the price will increase for the Full Retail version.”

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
“The main point of communication will be the Piko Piko Steam Community Hub, where we can interact with users who will be leaving ideas, feedback and bug reports for the title! While we are unable to promise that every request will be put into the game we will be doing our best to keep the community up to date on what the new changes are through simple change logs and help spotlight interesting threads or reports to further the conversation on particular topics.”

General Discussion Forums
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1079200/discussions/

Bug Report Sub-Forums
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1079200/discussions/1/

Feedback Sub-Forums
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1079200/discussions/2/
